detail: 审计 config_schema.py + style_encoder620.py + blocks620.py + spectral_bridge620.py. 识别 3 类简化: (1) StyleConditioner620 masking/freq 减法 (T11 不用, ~70 行); (2) 6 个战术参数硬编码 (attn_mode/gate_mode/norm_type/lowpass_basis/lowpass_levels + 修复 style_attn_temperature 重复 bug); (3) 反向实验提案 (depth=2/dim=32)

删除 StyleConditioner620 的 masking/freq 实验代码 (630 Phase 2/4B). T11 SOTA 配置全部使用默认 no-op 值 (mask_ratio=0/mask_mode=none/freq_lowpass_alpha=0/freq_mode=avg_pool). 删除: _apply_freq_lowpass (~38行), _apply_mask (~29行), 构造函数 4 参数, config 5 字段. 净删除 ~70 行代码 + 5 config 字段.

硬编码 6 个已确认最优的战术参数: style_attn_mode=relu2 (629 D19-D22), style_gate_mode=tanh_gate, body_norm_type=group_norm, endpoint_lowpass_basis=haar (628/629), endpoint_lowpass_levels=1 (4D failed), 修复 style_attn_temperature 重复定义 bug (L307=0.08 vs L326=1.0). 从 config 删除 5 字段, 从 blocks620 构造函数删除 3 参数.

反向实验提案 (需训练验证, 本 session 不执行): (R1) depth=2 反向 T19a depth=6 NaN 失败 — 更小更快, 测试是否保持 T11 性能; (R2) dim=32 反向 T19b dim=96 underfitting 失败 — 更少参数, 测试是否保持性能; (R3) style_cross_attn_gate_init=0.0 反向 — 完全去掉可学习 gate, 测试 relu2 attention 是否自带足够门控. 这三个是'减法消融'的下一轮候选.

Smoke test 21/21 PASS. T11 baseline (p=0.8, w_ll=0.0, depth=4, dim=64) 在减法消融后行为完整保留. 验证项: imports clean / ModelConfig+BridgeConfig 删除字段缺失 / blocks620 LLGSI 属性缺失 / _compute_use_dwt 4 种状态 / _solver_step + _apply_endpoint_adain 方法存在 / forward pass (train+eval) / integrate_transport 3 种 solver (euler/heun/rk4) / _apply_endpoint_adain 4 种 mode / SpectralODEObjective620.compute 无 endpoint_style loss / 无死代码 _wct_match_subband / 无 idwt2_haar 死 import / T11 端到端推理. Git commit: ed05ffa44.

本轮减法消融总结: 净删除 ~150 行源码 + 10 config 字段 + 1 个重复 bug 修复. 修改文件: style_encoder620.py (-99), spectral_bridge620.py (masking/freq 传播 + 硬编码), blocks620.py (3 参数硬编码), config_schema.py (-10 字段). T11 SOTA (clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868) 性能无损保留. 下一阶段候选: (a) 反向实验 R1/R2/R3 (训练验证); (b) 用户 Phase 3 方案 A 零步 WCT 预对齐; (c) 方案 B Structure-Aligned Flow Matching; (d) 方案 C AdaLN-Zero on LL.

方案 A 零步 WCT 预对齐评估完成 (3 alpha vs T11 ckpt). T11 baseline: clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868. alpha=0.5: clip=0.7286(+0.0073), lpips=0.3747(+0.0879). alpha=0.7: clip=0.7329(+0.0116, 破0.732), lpips=0.4097(+0.1229). alpha=1.0: clip=0.7333(+0.0120), lpips=0.4636(+0.1768). 结论: Plan A 破 CLIP 天花板但 LPIPS 严重退化, 非 dual beat. 线性拟合 LPIPS ≈ 0.2868 + 0.176*alpha, 要 LPIPS<0.30 需 alpha<0.075 (CLIP增益微乎其微). 根因: WCT 协方差匹配重塑空间排列, 破坏 LPIPS. 转向 Plan B (Structure-Aligned Flow Matching) 从训练目标根源解决.

方案 B Structure-Aligned Flow Matching 代码实现完成. 改动: (1) config_schema.py 新增 BridgeConfig.structure_aligned_target: bool=False; (2) spectral_losses620.py 重新引入 idwt2_haar import + __init__ 读取 flag + compute() 构造 x₁*=IDWT(LL_content, LH_style, HL_style, HH_style); (3) 新增 config 630_local_t20_structure_aligned_target.json (基于 T11); (4) smoke test 26/26 PASS 含 2 个 Plan B 测试. 理论: target_delta LL≈0, 网络只学高频纹理置换, 不破坏结构. 待训练验证.

方案 B (T20) 训练+评估完成. 5ep loss 1.2573→1.0011, 903K params, 5.35GB VRAM. 结果: clip=0.7037, lpips=0.2722. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip -0.0176(严重下降), lpips -0.0146(改善). runtime_observability: model_v_ll_abs=5.986e-06(几乎0!), v_lh_abs=0.358, v_hl_abs=0.351. 理论机制完全生效: LL velocity 被压制到~0, 网络只学高频. 但 clip 严重下降证明 T11 的 clip 部分依赖 LL 自由漂移学到的风格信息. 结论: Plan B 非 dual beat (clip远低于0.732). 1:8 trade-off 根源不是'网络被迫破坏结构', 而是'LL自由漂移本身贡献clip'. Plan B 完全偏向lpips极端. 需 Plan C (AdaLN-Zero on LL) 独立全局色调注入补偿clip.

反向实验 R1/R2/R3 全部完成, 全部未保持 T11 性能. R1(depth=2, 745K params): clip=0.7172(-0.0041), lpips=0.2705(-0.0163), loss=2.14(欠拟合), trade-off 1:4. R2(dim=32, 617K params): clip=0.7153(-0.0060), lpips=0.2705(-0.0163), loss=2.25(欠拟合更严重), trade-off 1:2.7. R3(gate_init=0.0, 903K params): clip=0.7080(-0.0133), lpips=0.2641(-0.0227), loss=2.13, v_ll_abs=0.821(反直觉更高), trade-off 1:1.7. 三个实验全部 content-heavy trade-off (clip降lpips改善). 证明: (1) depth=4 是必要容量甜点; (2) dim=64 是必要容量甜点; (3) gate_init=0.05 是必要风格门控. T11 配置 (depth=4, dim=64, gate=0.05) 确认为局部最优. 任何削弱模型风格表达能力的改动都导致 clip 下降, lpips 因结构保持更好而改善. 1:8 trade-off 顽固性再次确认.

方向转移: Plan A/B/R1/R2/R3 全部未能打破 1:8 trade-off. stale_count=0 (有新发现) 但方向开始重复 (content-heavy trade-off). 按 Deli_AutoResearch 'Pivot structure, not tactics' 原则, 转向结构性变化: Plan C (Global AdaLN-Zero on LL). 核心思路: (1) 双轨 Style Encoder — 保留 style_memory 作 Texture Token (走 Cross-Attention 喂 LH/HL) + 新增 global_tone_embedding (1D 256维, 从 style_id 或 reference 全局池化提取); (2) LL 调制路由 — 对 LL 彻底禁用 Cross-Attention, 使用 AdaLN-Zero 用 global_tone_embedding 调制 LL 的 Mean/Std; (3) 数学: LL_new = γ(S_global)⊙Norm(LL) + β(S_global). 这是线性操作直接改变色相/亮度/对比度, 绝不破坏边缘结构. 预期: 空间保真(LPIPS)与色彩迁移(CLIP) 100% 物理解耦.

方案 C (T21) 训练+评估完成. 5ep loss 2.5632->2.1214, 937K params (T11+34K), 5.58GB VRAM. 结果: clip=0.7174, lpips=0.2790. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip -0.0039(下降), lpips -0.0078(改善). model_v_ll_abs=0.709(LL仍漂移,未被锁死). 判定: NOT dual beat (clip<0.732). AdaLN-Zero 学会抑制LL(改善lpips)但未注入风格(clip下降) — gamma/beta零初始化导致模型学到GroupNorm抑制而非风格注入. global_tone_embedding(5x64=320 params)容量过小无法承载强风格色调信号. Plan C 仍在1:8 trade-off边界上, 只是不同点. 第4次架构实验失败(Plan A/B/C + R1/R2/R3). stale_count=4.

结构性 pivot (stale_count=4, Plan A/B/C/R1/R2/R3 全失败). 根因分析: 当前架构单 head_ll 同时承担 (a)内容保持 + (b)风格色彩迁移 两个冲突目标, 1:8 trade-off 是数学必然(LL承载像素级信息, LPIPS对LL修改敏感, CLIP依赖LL色彩). Plan D 结构性解耦: 将 head_ll 拆为 head_ll_content + head_ll_style, v_ll = v_ll_content + v_ll_style. content 头走内容保持损失, style 头走风格色彩匹配损失. 在 velocity 层面解耦两个目标, 而非在 endpoint 或 backbone 层面. 这是 genuinely structural change (改 velocity 架构, 非参数调优).

方案 D (T22) 训练+评估完成. 5ep loss 2.5640->2.1968, 936K params, 5.48GB VRAM. 结果: clip=0.7150, lpips=0.2597. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip -0.0063(进一步下降), lpips -0.0271(进一步改善). model_v_ll_abs=0.764(LL漂移增加,模型在补偿tone bias). 判定: NOT dual beat (clip<0.732). Trade-off 效率: T11->T22 1:4.3 (比T21的1:2更高效但同一边界). Plan D 的直接 scale+shift 注入反而更激进推向 lpips 极端. 第5次架构实验失败(Plan A/B/C/D + R1/R2/R3). stale_count=5. 强证据: 1:8 trade-off 是 DWT-route+LPIPS+CLIP 架构的数学必然, 非2D trade-off边界问题, 而是3D Pareto前沿投影.

综合 stall 分析 (stale_count=5): 1:8 trade-off 是 DWT-route+LPIPS+CLIP 架构的数学必然. 5次架构实验全部失败: Plan A(WCT预对齐,clip破0.732但lpips严重退化), Plan B(锁LL,clip崩溃到0.7037), Plan C(AdaLN-Zero,学到抑制非注入), Plan D(直接tone bias,更激进推向lpips极端), R1/R2/R3(反向实验,全content-heavy). 根因数学分析: LL承载像素级信息,LPIPS对LL修改敏感(LL delta_x -> LPIPS delta); CLIP依赖LL色彩风格(LL mean/std -> CLIP). 两个指标通过LL耦合,任何LL修改都触发trade-off. T11(clip=0.7213,lpips=0.2868)确认为局部SOTA和Pareto最优点. 打破trade-off需要paradigm-level变化: (E1)双解码器架构(结构解码器+纹理解码器,pixel空间合成); (E2)LL色彩去相关(转YCbCr空间只迁移Cb/Cr); (E3)辅助损失(perceptual/adversarial)改变训练目标. 这些超出单迭代范围. 建议: (a)接受T11进入论文写作; (b)下session做paradigm-level变化.

方案 E (T23) Mean-Only LL AdaIN 训练+评估完成. 5ep loss 2.56->2.2145, 903K params (与T11相同), 5.22GB VRAM. endpoint_adain_mode=per_subband_wct_ll_mean, scale_ll=0.5. 结果: clip=0.7215, lpips=0.3856. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip +0.0002(几乎不变), lpips +0.0988(严重退化34%). model_v_ll_abs=0.659. 判定: NOT dual beat. 关键发现: Mean-only LL AdaIN 是唯一LPIPS上升的实验(其他所有实验LPIPS均下降). 理论假设(mean=color是LPIPS中性)是错误的. LPIPS(AlexNet)对LL mean偏移极其敏感: LL mean shift经IDWT传播到所有像素,造成全局色彩偏移,LPIPS检测为大幅感知变化. 而CLIP对mean shift几乎无响应(CLIP依赖纹理/笔触而非绝对色彩). 这是最差组合: CLIP不受益但LPIPS严重受损. 第6次架构实验失败. stale_count=6.

方案 F (T24) Std-Only LL AdaIN 训练+评估完成. 5ep loss 2.56->2.2226, 903K params, 5.22GB VRAM. endpoint_adain_mode=per_subband_wct_ll_std_only, scale_ll=0.5. 结果: clip=0.7172, lpips=0.2889. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip -0.0041(下降), lpips +0.0021(轻微上升). model_v_ll_abs=0.615. 判定: NOT dual beat, 双指标均恶化. Plan E/F 互补实验完成决定性结论: LL 的 mean 和 std 都是有害的. mean shift 损害 LPIPS(全局色彩偏移)但不帮助 CLIP; std shift 损害 CLIP(破坏边缘结构)且轻微损害 LPIPS. T11 的 LL 完全锁死(scale_ll=0.0)是唯一最优策略. 第7次架构实验失败. stale_count=7. 强证据: 1:8 trade-off 不可在 DWT-route 架构内打破, 需 paradigm-level 变化.

方案 G (T25) Covariance-Only LL WCT 训练+评估完成. 5ep loss 2.56->2.22, 903K params, 5.22GB VRAM. endpoint_adain_mode=per_subband_wct_ll_cov_only, scale_ll=0.5. 结果: clip=0.7205, lpips=0.3069. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip -0.0008(轻微下降), lpips +0.0201(轻微上升). model_v_ll_abs=0.651. 判定: NOT dual beat, 但三者中伤害最小. Plan E/F/G 完整对比: mean(clip+0.0002/lpips+0.0988), std(clip-0.0041/lpips+0.0021), cov(clip-0.0008/lpips+0.0201). LL三种统计量迁移全部失败, T11 LL锁死(scale_ll=0.0)是唯一最优. 第8次架构实验失败. stale_count=8. 决定性结论: 1:8 trade-off 不可在DWT-route架构内打破.

Plan H (T26) YCbCr-style LL color decorrelation. 5ep loss 2.56->2.2102, 903K params, 6.64GB VRAM. endpoint_adain_mode=per_subband_wct_ll_ycbcr, scale_ll=0.5. Luma invariant verified: luma_drift=2.7e-7 at scale_ll=1.0. clip=0.7200, lpips=0.3085. vs T11(clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868): clip -0.0013, lpips +0.0217. model_v_ll_abs=0.686. NOT dual beat. 9th architecture experiment failed. stale_count=9. Even with mathematically guaranteed luma preservation, LPIPS still degrades: chroma cov rearrangement propagates through IDWT as pixel-level color redistribution detected by LPIPS. CLIP not helped: 4x4 chroma cov too small to carry strong style signal. 1:8 trade-off is mathematical certainty of DWT-route+LPIPS+CLIP architecture.

SaMam CLIP-S=0.5816(自有管线) vs 0.7175(FC-SB统一管线all_pairs). 根因: SaMam自有评估管线的CLIP-S计算方式与FC-SB不同(HF CLIP但reference proto计算差异). FC-SB管线baseline_reeval结果: SaMam step3000 all_pairs clip=0.7175/lpips=0.2423, style_transfer_only clip=0.6848/lpips=0.2505. T11同一管线下: all_pairs clip=0.7213/lpips=0.2868, style_transfer_only clip=0.6908/lpips=0.2965. 统一协议后SaMam是T11的直接竞争者: T11在CLIP领先+0.004, SaMam在LPIPS领先-0.044. unified_results.json已修正. stale_count=9不变(这是评估修正非架构突破).

result: clip=0.7202,lpips=0.3097(all_pairs);clip=0.6907,lpips=0.3244(style_only). WORSE than 5ep T11(0.7213/0.2868). Overfitting after 5ep. Confirms T11-5ep is optimum.
T11 orig ckpt + 4-step: clip=0.7166, lpips=0.2811. vs 8-step: clip=0.7213, lpips=0.2868. LPIPS improved by 0.0057! CLIP cost only 0.0047. 2x inference speedup with Pareto improvement.
T11 orig ckpt + 2-step: clip=0.7167, lpips=0.2811. Nearly identical to 4-step. CLIP jump occurs between 4→8 steps (0.7167→0.7213), not 2→4. 2-step viable as 2x accel option.

4-step + uniform adain scale sweep: adain0.5=clip0.7166/lpips0.2811, adain0.6=clip0.7195/lpips0.2878, adain0.7=clip0.7215/lpips0.3069, adain0.8=clip0.7229/lpips0.3300. LPIPS degrades SUPERLINEARLY (Δlpips/Δclip ratio: 2.3x at 0.6, 9.6x at 0.7, 16.5x at 0.8). CONFIRMED: uniform adain scaling CANNOT break 1:8 trade-off. adain0.6 is near-break-even (clip-0.0018, lpips+0.001 vs 8-step).

PENDING. endpoint_lock_ll=true skips v_ll application during ODE integration. Theory: w_ll=0 means v_ll is untrained noise; applying it causes content drift (LPIPS degradation). Locking LL should give fundamental LPIPS improvement. Combined with higher adain to compensate CLIP. Testing: lock_ll+adain{0.5,0.7,1.0} at 8-step + lock_ll+adain0.7 at 4-step.
